facts.business: CP Capital Limited is a listed Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) providing secured property-backed loans to self-employed individuals, proprietors, and MSMEs, bridge/bullet loans based on cash-flow, and hypothecation-backed lending to partner NBFCs.

segments.name: Secured property-backed loans to self-employed individuals, proprietors, and MSMEs
Bridge/bullet loans to entrepreneurs and enterprises based on cash-flow
Hypothecation-backed lending to partner NBFCs secured against underlying loan receivables

guidance_or_targets.statement: Deepen leadership in secured, property-backed lending; extend disciplined credit to India's underserved MSME segment; advance digital transformation roadmap for faster, safer, and more scalable origination, underwriting, and collections.

key_risks: Estimation of expected credit losses (ECL) involves significant estimation in grouping borrowers, staging loans, determining macro-economic factors, and estimating losses for products with minimal historical defaults.
